assay: bulk RNA-seq of heart (BGI), STAR mm10 read counts (S2.2.p2)
sample_inclusion: RNA-seq: male MerCreMer control vs cYY1 KO mice after TAC, n=4 per group (S2.2.p2; FIG3 n=4)

factors.name: stress
levels: TAC only in the sequenced set

exercise_arm: Two-week swimming (S2.1.p2) was studied only by echocardiography, qPCR of Ppargc1a/Ppara/Esrra, citrate synthase and co-IP (S3.1.p1, FIG1, FIG4). No swimming or sedentary heart was sequenced.
primary_estimand: RNA-seq estimand: effect of cardiac YY1 deletion on the TAC-stressed heart transcriptome (cYY1 KO vs MerCreMer control, both TAC). The exercise effect on gene expression is not an RNA-seq estimand in this paper.

planned_contrasts.name: KO_vs_ctrl_TAC
planned_contrasts.definition: cYY1 KO TAC vs MerCreMer control TAC

blocking_or_covariance.note: one heart per mouse, between-animal arms

enrichment.method: IPA on DEGs, pathway FDR 5% (S2.2.p2); no executor (proprietary IPA)

internal_discrepancy: TAC duration: 'one week' (S2.2.p2) vs '10 days after TAC' (FIG3)
